steps.text:
I fixed the parsing, and all 4 tests pass.

The cause was in `src/csv.js`. `parseLine` used `line.split(',')`, so a name like `"Acme, Inc."` split into two fields. Every later column shifted right, which is how the amount ended up in the wrong place.

I replaced it with a small character-by-character parser. Commas inside double quotes now stay in the field, and a doubled quote (`""`) inside a quoted field becomes a literal `"`. Unquoted fields are still trimmed, as before.

`parseInvoices` splits the text on newlines before parsing, so a quoted field that contains a line break would still break. I left that alone since you only asked about commas.

I haven't committed anything.
